The conclusion rejects the enumerated constructions under the frozen model, not every fused or synthesized GF(2) circuit.
conclusion: No count or accounting blocker found. The free-shift, free-selection, cheapest-map oracle fails the frozen 26 B/s source-operation screen, and its complete comparable source ledger is worse than the beta reference.
